title: Text: DET Ron Colangelo ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Just calling to wish you a great day
Anything pressing? You just spent two days with Al.
I didn't call Al. Nothing pressing, though.
Still interested in chatting if you have some time
I spoke with the Tigers owner this morning...
I'll give you the details when we talk but I want the Chris Ilitch profile. Called you immediately after, sorry if I woke you.
I was getting kids ready for school, your pal, Nico
Nice. Why would you pick 12:15 p.m. on Saturday to talk? Don't you work in the office Monday-Friday?
I am available then... and yes I work Monday - Friday but I am always on the clock
Was just curious. It's a random time and on weekend
Don't ever let yourself be predictable
